Changelog

spikeyglass (development version)

Bug fixes

  • lambda2 = 0 (separate estimation) no longer sets every posterior inclusion probability to 0. The E-step evaluated log(lambda2 / v), which is -Inf for both spike and slab, so the posterior was NaN and was replaced by 0. A penalty with lambda = 0 now contributes no prior terms to the E-step. The same applies to lambda1 = 0. Fixed in both the R and C++ E-steps.

  • Imputation no longer fails when a group has exactly one missing cell (getmissing() dropped the missing-cell index matrix to a vector).

  • fit$imputed is no longer all NA when normalize = FALSE, and imputed values are always returned on the original data scale. The conditional-mean imputation assumes mean-zero data, so the data are now always centred internally when there are cells to impute. Previously, with normalize = FALSE, imputations were shrunk towards 0 rather than towards the variable means. Fits without missing data are unaffected, because the sample covariance is centred anyway.

  • With missing data, the M-step now uses the expected sample covariance given the observed data, S(imputed) + (sum of conditional covariances) / n, as in Li et al. (2019), supplement B. Previously this correction was used only for block screening, and the ADMM recomputed S from the imputed data alone. As a result, the internal ADMM now takes covariance matrices rather than data, and the singleton-node solver is vendored from JGL (JGL:::admm.iters.unconnected is no longer called).

  • The non-doubly R E-step (gete()) now uses the log-sum-exp trick, matching the C++ version. It no longer returns NaN when both the spike and slab log-densities underflow.

  • In the R EM path (fused penalty with K > 2, or imputation), pi2list is no longer updated when doubly = FALSE. It now stays at a / (a + b), matching the C++ path. It was previously reported as (a - 1) / (a + b + n_edges - 2), which is meaningless without a similarity indicator.

Breaking changes

  • The warm and warm.connected arguments of ssjgl() have been removed. They were accepted but never used.

Testing

  • New regression tests for each fix above, plus a test that the C++ and R EM paths agree to 1e-10 for fused/group penalties with and without the doubly prior (K = 2).

spikeyglass 0.0.0.9000

  • Added a NEWS.md file to track changes to the package.
